title: Gate shift sign-in missing: gate_sessions never written, all guard routes 403
expected: Guard can sign into an authorized gate and start a shift attributed to officer/device/location
actual: No POST existed for gate_sessions; getGuardContext always null so every guard-gated endpoint returned 403 "No active gate session"

title: Access-code creation accepted inverted/past windows and malformed contacts; collision 500; Math.random codes
expected: Bad input rejected with clear validation; out-of-policy code not issued; blacklist-aware issuance
actual: validityEnd<=validityStart and wholly-past windows inserted silently; any phone string accepted; partial-unique collision -> 500; Math.random used for the bearer code; no watchlist check
root_cause: No validation or retry logic on the BFF route (the Go path validated dates)

title: Gate approve admitted expired/revoked/over-used/blacklisted codes and never consumed uses
expected: First valid scan consumes the code; subsequent/expired/revoked/blacklisted/former-resident scans denied; exactly one scanner wins a race
actual: Any active-session guard could check in ANY existing code regardless of status/validity/uses/blacklist; used_count was never incremented (one-time codes reusable forever)
root_cause: Handler validated existence+estate only; no admission predicates and no atomic consumption

title: Duplicate unit label accepted within an estate
expected: Duplicate unit key rejected within estate
actual: No code check and no DB unique constraint — identical unit_label+block inserted freely
root_cause: Constraint never modeled in schema or code

title: Blacklist write 500 on missing reason; gate lookup only matched plates; no lookup rate limit
expected: Watchlist blocks/routes review without arbitrary disclosure; invalid-code probing rate-limited
actual: reason NOT NULL violated -> 500 when omitted; lookup checked only vehicle_plate so phone/blacklist flags were missed; unlimited guessing of the 6-digit space
root_cause: Incomplete coverage of blacklist match kinds; no throttling on the enumeration endpoint

title: Offline gate events could not be uploaded; replayed sync would double-count
expected: Each offline event uploaded once with original timestamps; idempotent replay
actual: Sync only flipped pending->synced; no event payload accepted and no dedup key existed
root_cause: No upload contract or client-event id in the sync design

title: No code-regeneration path for a compromised share
expected: Former code invalidated and replacement linked to history
actual: Only revoke+recreate manually; no atomic regenerate endpoint

title: Unit archive ignored dependencies (active tenant / open invoice)

title: CheckInVisitor read-then-write race allowed double admission on concurrent scans
expected: Exactly one of two simultaneous scans admitted
actual: Two txs both passed the allowed check and both incremented used_count past max_uses
root_cause: Admission decision and consumption not atomic

title: Estate lifecycle & governance schema absent: no draft/publish/verify/deactivate/transfer/tz/branding
expected: Estate has draft state, publish, verification, deactivation, ownership transfer, timezone, branding
actual: CLOSED by Phase 2.3 on 2026-10-27. The status machine from caef65516 (pending -> verify -> active -> suspend -> reactivate -> close, review queue, actor-attributed status changes, legal hold) is now asserted over HTTP and against the live database rather than only by Go tests (EXEC-ESTA-026: 140 PASS / 0 FAIL; EXEC-ESTA-025: 10 PASS / 0 FAIL), and everything the PARTIAL note listed as absent has been built: estates.timezone validated against pg_timezone_names by trigger and by constraint; estates.branding (four allow-listed keys, #rrggbb, http(s), 4 KB) and estates.notice (2000 runes, counted in characters not bytes); estates.duplicate_suspected with normalised (name,address) detection that holds a twin in the review queue instead of publishing it; estate_config_revisions written by an AFTER trigger under pg_advisory_xact_lock with previous_value, newest-first, and no rows for untouched columns; estate_owner_transfers with a one-pending partial unique and a single SECURITY DEFINER writer so ownership moves only on the incoming owner's accept. Deliberate remaining shape, recorded so it is not mistaken for an oversight: the pre-publication state is 'pending' (an application in the platform queue), not a separately editable draft; a handover transfers the estate, not individual units; branding and timezone are stored, validated and served but no client renders them and no estate code reads the zone for computation; and the surface sits behind FEATURE_ESTATE_LIFECYCLE_ENABLED / FEATURE_ESTATE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED, both false by default.
root_cause: Feature set never modeled; needs additive migrations (deferred to consolidation)

title: Estate role model is binary (resident|estate_admin): no finance/gate/election/facility/auditor/temporary delegations
expected: Scoped delegated roles with least privilege and expiring assignments
actual: PARTIAL as of 554173ae0: estate_staff_grants gives 7 expiring, revocable, admin-delegated roles and the gate path is genuinely least-privilege (assertGate fail-closed; EST-UAT-0056/0061/0068 now PASS via EXEC-ESTA-014). Updated 2026-10-27 (Phase 2.3): EST-UAT-0028 is closed — estate_invite_codes.role (migration 20271099000050) lets an admin mint a manager code, an omitted role defaults to resident, a resident code cannot demote a sitting owner and grants no admin surface, proven live in EXEC-ESTA-025/026. Still open: finance_officer/election_officer/facility_officer/meeting_secretary/auditor are grantable but consulted by no action path (EXEC-ESTA-016), enforcement sits behind FEATURE_ESTATE_GUARD_GRANTS which defaults false, and estate_residents.role is still the binary resident|estate_admin super-role enum — deliberately, because the invite CHECK is bounded by estate_residents_role_check and widening it is a schema-plus-service change, not an invite change
root_cause: Role enum CHECK constraint limits the model; widening needs schema + service changes

title: Merchant onboarding lacks withdraw/suspend/reactivate; resubmit only from NEEDS_MORE_INFO

title: No per-gate assignment, supervisor-override permission, identity check, or device binding at the gate
expected: Gate-specific passes honored; overrides require authorized role + reason; unenrolled devices denied
actual: Live-confirmed 2026-10-26 on the shipped surface (EXEC-ESTA-022): a plain resident with NO estate_staff_grants row opened POST /api/v1/visitor/gate/session (201), read gate/expected (200) and admitted a visitor via gate/approve (200) - the BFF authorises gate work by estate membership only. On the Go stack the guard admit path is fail-closed (estate_staff_grants + assertGate -> ErrNotMember/ErrInsufficientRole/ErrAccountBanned/ErrAccountDeleted, proven by the live-DB suite in EXEC-ESTA-014 and over HTTP in EXEC-ESTA-017) but only behind FEATURE_ESTATE_GUARD_GRANTS, which defaults to false (EXEC-ESTA-018). Still open in both stacks: no code.gate assignment, no supervisor-override permission for walk-in, no identity check, no device enrolment
root_cause: Gate-policy model not designed (schema gaps: code.gate, device registry, supervisor role)

title: Resident real-time approval flow absent (approve/decline/timeout)
expected: Entry permitted only after resident approval; decline and timeout enforced
actual: Live-confirmed 2026-10-26 (EXEC-ESTA-022): a pass requested with requireHostApproval:true is stored with require_host_approval = f because the codes insert list in frontend-web/app/api/v1/visitor/codes/route.ts omits the column, and a guard then admitted that pass (200) with no host decision - the flag is neither persisted nor consulted on the shipped path. The Go service does model it end to end (visitor_arrival_requests pending/approved/declined, RequestArrival/DecideArrival routes, admission denied until approval, single-use approvals, 15-min TTL; EXEC-ESTA-014) but that stack is not what mobile calls, and nothing writes status='timeout' for a request the host never answers
root_cause: Approval workflow not modeled (no pending-approval status on codes/visits)

title: No visitor PII retention/purge policy
expected: PII hidden/purged/anonymized after retention threshold
actual: Codes expire but visitor name/phone/plate persist forever
root_cause: Retention job only flips status; no anonymization step

title: Estate directory enumerable by any authenticated user while FEATURE_ESTATE_GUARD_GRANTS is at its default
expected: Discovery is membership-scoped (or explicitly scoped public-by-consent) regardless of flag state
actual: Confirmed live on :8094 with the flag unset: GET /api/finance/estate?limit=50 as a user with no membership returns the full row set (id, name, admin_id, created_at); the same call on :8093 with the flag on returns {"data":null}. listAllEstates() is the documented pre-#876 behaviour, so the fail-closed discovery rule only exists when a non-default flag is turned on
root_cause: Caller-scoping of estate discovery was coupled to the guard-grants flag instead of being its own always-on rule

title: Gate lookup id-prefix branch can never match and the failure is reported as not-found
expected: The documented lookup works by numeric_code or by id prefix, and a broken query is distinguishable from an unknown code
actual: Live (EXEC-ESTA-022): lookup?code=<first 8 chars of an issued pass id> answers 200 {"found":false}. The id-prefix filter is a PostgREST 404 with sqlcode 42883 operator does not exist: uuid ~~* unknown (same error raised directly in psql against supabase_db_spotlight), and the route destructures only { data: rows }, discarding error, so the operator sees 'not found' for a query that never ran
root_cause: visitor_access_codes.id is a uuid column, so ILIKE needs a cast (id::text ilike ...); the swallowed Supabase error converts a broken query into a false negative

title: CSV pass import reports no per-row outcome, so malformed rows vanish silently
expected: Import responds with the accepted count plus which rows were skipped and why (or fails the batch)
actual: Live (EXEC-ESTA-021): a 3-row CSV whose last line is malformed returns 201 {"imported":2}; nothing tells the operator a row was dropped. The insert is also one batch, so a single bad value would reject every row while the success path implies partial acceptance
root_cause: rows are filtered on required fields before insert and the response only counts inserted rows

title: The BFF estate write gate (fc6fd64f7) shipped without fixture support, silently invalidating 23 visitor/estate specs
expected: A behaviour change lands with the fixtures it depends on, so a red suite is visible in the commit that caused it rather than five days later
actual: fc6fd64f7 added assertEstateWritable, which answers 423 unless estates.status='active', while those four specs create no estates row at all: 23 specs went red and the 20 estate-a cases whose evidence cites them silently lost their proof from 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-26. Repaired 2026-10-26 by seeding status='active' into the fixtures and adding 2 negative 423 specs (EXEC-ESTA-013 now reports 12 files / 116 tests green); the repair is in the working tree and committed in c4c69e0cd (2026-10-27). Production was never locked out — estates.status is NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' — so this is a test-integrity/ledger defect, not a user-facing one
root_cause: The write gate was landed without running the suite that exercises it, and the fixtures predated the column

title: POST /estate accepted a name made of spaces and queued a live estate
expected: A missing or blank estate name is refused with 400 before anything is stored
actual: Found live on 2026-10-27 (EXEC-ESTA-026 first run): {'name':'   '} returned 201 and created a real estate held in the platform review queue; a padded name was stored untrimmed and slipped past the duplicate lookup
root_cause: Gin's binding:'required,min=2' counts characters, so three spaces satisfy it, and nothing re-checked the value in the service before the INSERT. Fixed in CreateEstate: trim, require at least 2 runes, refuse with the new ErrEstateNameRequired sentinel mapped to 400, store the trimmed name and use it for estateDuplicateLookup. The estate the first run created (43543a7e-7ae9-4c7a-9707-952d74812406) was closed over the real reject transition rather than deleted out of the ledger.

title: Estate governance routes answered caller mistakes with 500 instead of 400
expected: A bad query parameter, an out-of-range field or an impossible target is a refused request (400) with the reason, not a server failure (500)
actual: Found live on 2026-10-27 (EXEC-ESTA-026 first run and the spot checks that followed it): an over-length resident notice, an unknown ?column= on /admin/config/history, an unknown ?status= on /owner-transfers, an unparseable or self to_user_id on POST /owner-transfer and an unknown timezone on POST /estate each returned 500
root_cause: The service returned bare fmt.Errorf values and parse errors, and the httperr rule table had no 400 bucket for them. Fixed with sentinels — ErrNoticeTooLong, ErrInvalidConfigColumn, ErrInvalidTransferFilter, ErrInvalidTransferTargetUser, ErrOwnerTransferToSelf, ErrInvalidTimezone, ErrEstateNameRequired — mapped to http.StatusBadRequest in profile_handler.go and handler.go; the live-DB tests now assert with errors.Is rather than matching message text.
